status: M4 integrated digital candidate; operational hardware qualification pending
imu: ST LSM6DSOTR, raw LGA14, SPI mode 3 per DS12140
logic_regulator: Pololu D36V28F5 #3782, 5V, 50V input maximum; wired adapter; TLV803EB46 supervisor

power_analysis.note: Historical first-pass behavioral parameters; current consolidated power/thermal/startup assumptions are in config/power-stage.json and closure/policy-config.json. No approved exact actuator limits.

notes: All firmware voltage/temperature thresholds are provisional design assumptions, not exact actuator ratings.
Physical dimensions and mass allocations come from config/robot.json; board geometry derives at the CAD boundary.
Teensy VUSB-VIN link must be cut before powered USB attachment; direct solder mounting avoids tall sockets.
Hardware stop must independently interrupt actuator power; MCU stop_loop is monitor only.
Keep shunt downstream of the actuator disconnect, with an independent source for its comparator/gate driver.
Independent startup permission defaults low and requires calibrated voltage sensing, bounded idle startup load, verified watchdog/IO cutoff and cooldown.
Roof thermistor case-temperature error including mounting/dynamic lag must be qualified before enabling physical power.
Power J4-J6/J9/J10 use specified low-profile soldered wires; native 4-layer power stack keeps 70um outer current paths and 35um inner signals.
